title: British Feet Grew Two Shoe Sizes
hook: Shoe sizes rose because adult feet are changing in two directions.
closing: Bigger bodies can reshape adult feet, so old shoe sizes may no longer fit.
question: Has your shoe size changed?

segments.say: British men's average shoe size grew by two sizes. The change is too large to dismiss as fashion.
About 67% of women say their feet widened in adulthood. Growth is happening across the foot, not just along it.
About 66% of adults in England are overweight or obese. Extra weight helps explain why adult feet spread.
